name: <Name of the dataset as specified in the readme - if applicable or 'N/A'>
readme_data_path: <path mentioned in the readme file where to where in the package the dataset is located - if applicable or 'N/A'>
package_data_path: <path relative to `package/<package-id>/` to the dataset file in the package - if applicable or 'N/A'. It is possible that several files match this dataset. data_availibility_statement.url: <URL to where the dataset can be accessed - if applicable or 'N/A'>
data_availibility_statement.access_instructions: <description of how to access the dataset as specified in the readme - if applicable or 'N/A'>
data_availibility_statement.rights_statement: <description of any rights statement related to the dataset as specified in the readme - if applicable or 'N/A'>
